note: Synthetic clips for engine-routing experiments (scripts/eval-routing.py). Every clip is recognised with the mode languages ru+en. 'inline' = Russian sentences with English terms inside, read by the Russian voice (as a Russian speaker would say them); 'mixed' = a sentence-level language switch without a pause.
